fields.name: grow
fields.description: Flex-grow factor: how much this item grows to fill extra space. Defaults to `0`.

fields.name: shrink
fields.description: Flex-shrink factor: how much this item shrinks when space is tight. Defaults to `1`.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: Flex-basis: the item's starting size before growing/shrinking. Defaults to `auto`.

fields.name: alignSelf
fields.description: Overrides the container's `align` for this item alone (CSS `align-self`).

fields.name: children
fields.description: Content rendered inside this flex item, e.g. sample filler content.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: Flex-direction: which way the main axis runs. Defaults to `row`.

fields.name: justify
fields.description:
Alignment along the main axis (horizontal for `row`, vertical for
`column`) — left / center / right plus the distributed-spacing modes.
Defaults to `start`.

fields.name: align
fields.description:
Alignment along the cross axis (vertical for `row`, horizontal for
`column`) — top / center / bottom / stretch / baseline.
Defaults to `stretch`.

fields.name: wrap
fields.description: Whether items wrap onto additional lines. Defaults to `nowrap`.

fields.name: gap
fields.description: Gap between items in pixels. Defaults to `12`.

fields.name: minHeight
fields.description: Minimum height in pixels, useful for previewing alignment on an otherwise short container.

fields.name: children
fields.description: Child elements laid out by this flex container.
